title: SSD1306 OLED, command subset

implements.text: Display on/off, invert and contrast commands; address 0x3C; the Adafruit_GFX text cursor rules (6x8 cells per text size)

unsupported.text: Bus time: a transfer completes instantly; pull-ups, clock stretching and repeated start are not modelled
Rendering of every command; only the subset is modelled

knownFailureCases: Commands outside the subset are accepted and ignored
